# Redefine Roofing

> Licensed and insured residential roofing contractor serving the Tampa Bay, Florida area since 2015. Redefine Roofing provides roof replacement, roof repair, storm damage and insurance claim assistance, gutters/soffit/fascia, attic ventilation and insulation, and roof inspections across six counties. Tagline: "Raising the Standard, ReDefining the Experience."

Redefine Roofing is a family-founded, education-first roofing company headquartered at 801 W Bay Dr, Suite 113, Largo, FL 33770. Phone: (813) 590-9050. Email: info@redefineroofing.com. Hours: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM daily, with 24/7 emergency service. Florida license CCC 1331457. Atlas Manufacturer Certified and CertainTeed certified, BBB A+ rated, NRCA member, 1000+ projects completed, 5-star average rating, lifetime workmanship warranty and 100% satisfaction guarantee. Free, no-pressure written estimates.

Service area: Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, Manatee, Sarasota, and Hernando Counties, Florida.

## Services

- [Roof Replacement](https://redefineroofing.com/services/roof-replacement/): Full tear-off and replacement using the complete Atlas Signature Select Roofing System, installed to exceed Florida Building Code wind requirements.
- [Roof Repair](https://redefineroofing.com/services/roof-repair/): Fast, honest repair of leaks, missing shingles, damaged flashing, and storm damage. 24/7 emergency service and same-day tarping.
- [Storm Damage & Insurance Claims](https://redefineroofing.com/services/storm-damage-insurance-claims/): Documentation and restoration for hurricane, wind, and hail damage; works directly with insurance carriers.
- [Gutters, Soffit & Fascia](https://redefineroofing.com/services/gutters-soffit-fascia/): Installation and repair of gutters, soffit, and fascia sized for Florida rainfall.
- [Ventilation & Insulation](https://redefineroofing.com/services/ventilation-insulation/): Attic ventilation and insulation assessments and upgrades to extend shingle life and cut cooling costs.
- [Roof Inspection](https://redefineroofing.com/services/roof-inspection/): Free, documented inspections for pre-purchase, pre-sale, post-storm, and insurance-renewal needs.

## Service Areas (counties)

- [Hillsborough County](https://redefineroofing.com/service-areas/hillsborough-county/): Tampa, Brandon, Riverview, Valrico, Plant City, Apollo Beach.
- [Pinellas County](https://redefineroofing.com/service-areas/pinellas-county/): St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Largo, Pinellas Park, Dunedin, Palm Harbor.
- [Pasco County](https://redefineroofing.com/service-areas/pasco-county/): New Port Richey, Wesley Chapel, Land O' Lakes, Zephyrhills, Trinity.
- [Manatee County](https://redefineroofing.com/service-areas/manatee-county/): Bradenton, Palmetto, Lakewood Ranch, Parrish.
- [Sarasota County](https://redefineroofing.com/service-areas/sarasota-county/): Sarasota, Venice, North Port, Nokomis.
- [Hernando County](https://redefineroofing.com/service-areas/hernando-county/): Brooksville, Spring Hill.
